data.name: Fakharon
data.gender_notes: Fakharon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is intelligent and wise, possessing deep understanding and knowledge. The name Fakharon carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Fakharon usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who seeks knowledge and wisdom from Allah, striving to be intelligent and wise in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Fakharon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fakharon total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فخارون
in_arabic.meaning: فخارون يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالفخر و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: فخارون هو اسم مشتق من الفخر و العزة، و يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالشرف و الكرامة. و هو اسم يوحي بالشخصية القوية و الذكية التي تتمتع بالفخر و العزة في نفسها و في مجتمعها. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق الحديث عن الكرامة و الشرف.

in_urdu.name: فخارون
in_urdu.meaning: فخارون مطلب ہے فخر و عزت والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فخارون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے فخر و عزت والا شخص۔ یہ نام شرف و کرامت کے احساس سے وابستہ ہے اور یہ شخص کی مضبوط و ذہین شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ یہ نام روایتی طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फखारोन
in_hindi.meaning: फखारोन का अर्थ है फखर और इज्जत वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फखारोन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है फखर और इज्जत वाला व्यक्ति। यह नाम सम्मान और गरिमा की भावना से जुड़ा हुआ है और यह व्यक्ति की मजबूत और बुद्धिमान व्यक्तित्व की ओर संकेत करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: فخارون
in_pashto.meaning: فخارون د فخر او عزت لرونکی سړی معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فخارون د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې د فخر او عزت لرونکی سړی دی. دا نوم د شراف او کرامت د احساس سره تړلی دی او دا د شخص د قوي او ذہین شخصیت نښه کوي. په افغانستان کې د پښتنو دودیزو نومونو کې دا نوم کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Fakharon
in_english.meaning: Fakharon means a person with pride and dignity
in_english.long_meaning: Fakharon is an Arabic name derived from the roots of 'fakhara', meaning pride and dignity. It signifies a person with a strong and intelligent personality, associated with honor and prestige. In Islamic tradition, the name Fakharon reflects the values of self-respect and nobility.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fakharon holds a high esteem and admiration in Islamic culture due to its affirmation of intelligence and wisdom. In a community that values knowledge and education, this name becomes a mark of respect and honor. Fakharon is also a name that represents the legacy and continuity of knowledge and intellectual pursuit, passed down from one generation to another.
data.spiritual_significance: Fakharon is a name rich in spiritual meaning as it embodies the pursuit of knowledge as a means to draw closer to God. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The searching for knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim." (Bukhari and Muslim). By giving their child the name Fakharon, Islamic parents are reminding them of their responsibility to seek knowledge and wisdom, which in turn brings them closer to their Creator. The name is a reminder of the value, power, and importance of knowledge in fulfilling the spiritual journey as a human being.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fakharon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of intelligent, wise.
